component: ConsoleUtilSSE NG (Ensrick rebuild for Skyrim SE 1.7.104)
purpose: DLL-only overlay above ConsoleUtilSSE NG 1.6.1 (Nexus 76649, file 793316). The official DLL fails to resolve VM class type 61 for GetSelectedReference / SetSelectedReference (its source predates CommonLibSSE-NG 68ae73e1cb99cdf81cd406918531d0570fe1e332, the 1.7.99+ SkyrimVM / PlayerCharacter layout fix); Proteus calls SetSelectedReference before console-driven actor operations.
